correctness.rationale: The complete six-dimensional F2 cubic space has 63 nonzero sections. Two exact independent algorithms (three-chart Gröbner and all singularity locations over F2/F4/F8 using a proven cubic singular-locus bound) agree on 18 smooth cubics and four smooth three-member pencils. All 168 projective transformations are enumerated and Boitrel’s theorem supplies the full C4 automorphism group; four pencils are one free orbit. The explicit lex Gröbner basis for two generators is squarefree and factors as irreducible degrees four and five, with no intersection at infinity; removing the four blown points leaves one reduced degree-five orbit. Included programs and reference results support each decisive finite computation.

value.rationale: The cyclic Frobenius-4 degree-five del Pezzo surface is one of the natural Galois forms in a complete geometric classification. The existence, full number and symmetry type of rational all-smooth anticanonical pencils over F2 are not automatic from surface classification. A single reduced Frobenius-transitive quintic base scheme in each pencil gives a structural arithmetic-geometric invariant, not just a small numerical gain; the claim completely answers the natural finite question on the surface.
